pairs.claim_text: Citizens should vote in every election.

pairs.assumption_text: Civic engagement improves democratic outcomes.
pairs.claim_text: The organization offers an on-ramp to civic engagement seminar titled 'Salt and Light'.

pairs.assumption_text: Concerned individuals have agency to effect change.
pairs.claim_text: Those individuals have recently realized that the government has become involved in their affairs.

pairs.assumption_text: Political engagement prevents excessive government intrusion into private life.
pairs.claim_text: Prayer should be directed toward elected officials and government leaders regardless of political party.
